description: This file defines a PHP trait named UserAgentTrait within the Aws\S3\Crypto namespace. The trait provides a method to append a custom User-Agent string to AWS S3 client requests by modifying the request headers using middleware.

classes.name: UserAgentTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing functionality to append a custom User-Agent string to AWS S3 client requests by modifying the request headers via middleware.

methods.name: appendUserAgent
methods.description: Appends a specified user agent string to the AWS client by adding middleware that modifies request headers.
